ideas.name: Gold delivery-month return premium
ideas.claim: The study reports a higher mean return for gold futures in their final trading month than in the preceding month, alongside the delivery notice period.
ideas.quote: Whereas the term structure was almost flat for oil, gold clearly shows a higher mean return for the last month.
ideas.mechanism: Delivery-related position unwinding and exposure to physical delivery.

rules.filters: Contracts grouped by remaining time to expiry.

ideas.claimed_result: Mean monthly log return was 0.33% for one-month contracts and -0.03% for two-month contracts.

ideas.name: Gold ETP flows and spot returns
ideas.claim: Weekly changes in gold ETP holdings were positively associated with gold spot returns in the same week; the study does not establish causality.
ideas.quote: In the case of gold, the R2 is considerably higher (almost 24 per cent) compared with the other two metals.
ideas.mechanism: Investment flows into and out of physically backed precious-metal products.

rules.market: Gold spot and physically backed gold ETPs

ideas.claimed_result: The same-week gold regression had an adjusted R2 of 23.75%; the one-week-lag Granger-causality test for flows predicting returns had p = 0.9006.
